item.title: YOLO Model Export Explained: 22 Formats, Parameters, and How to Choose
item.description: When I wrote “YOLO Deployment” in May 2026, the official Ultralytics export table had 17 rows. By September, when this post came together, it had grown to 22 — every new row is an NPU vendor pipeline: ExecuTorch, Axelera, DEEPX, Hailo, Huawei Ascend, Apple Core AI, and the like. The direction of growth is clear: training frameworks and inference hardware are drifting apart. PyTorch handles training, each deployment target runs its own runtime, and export is the only bridge between the two.
